text_1.title: MilestoneCode
text_1.description: Code of the milestone whose finish date changes, for example M1.

text_2.title: ProposedFinish
text_2.description: Proposed finish date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

number.title: ExpectedBaselineVersion
number.description: Optional. Baseline version the caller expects; a mismatch refuses the assessment.

boolean.title: UserConfirmed
boolean.description: True only after the user explicitly confirmed the exact assessment shown to them.

text_3.title: OriginalEvidence
text_3.description: The user's original wording of the change, stored verbatim as evidence.

inputs.name: Message
inputs.value: @concat('Requested baseline version ', string(triggerBody()?['number']), ' does not match current version ', string(outputs('Project')?['cr458_baselineversion']), '.')

inputs.name: Message
inputs.value: @concat('Proposed finish ', trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text_2'],'')), ' is not an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Relative dates are not interpreted.')

inputs.name: Message
inputs.value: @concat('Proposed finish ', trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text_2'],'')), ' is outside calendar ', outputs('Project')?['cr458_calendarcode'], '. The tool does not extrapolate.')

inputs.name: Message
inputs.value: @concat('The next working day after ', trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text_2'],'')), ' is outside the seeded calendar.')

inputs.name: Assumptions
inputs.value: @concat('Proposed finish ', trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text_2'],'')), ' falls on a non-working day; earliest effective completion is ', outputs('IdxDate')?[string(variables('EffectiveIdx'))], '.')

inputs.name: Assumptions
inputs.value: @concat('Calendar ', outputs('Project')?['cr458_calendarcode'], ': Monday to Friday working days. No public holidays configured.')

inputs.name: Message
inputs.value: @concat('The dependency graph for ', toUpper(trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text'],''))), ' contains a cycle. Assessment refused.')

inputs.name: Unknowns
inputs.value: @if(equals(items('Loop_milestones')?['cr458_durationdays'], null), concat('Finish for ', items('Loop_milestones')?['cr458_milestonecode'], ' cannot be computed: its duration is not documented.'), concat('A predecessor of ', items('Loop_milestones')?['cr458_milestonecode'], ' has no computable finish; its finish date cannot be computed.'))

inputs.select: @concat('| ', item()?['code'], ' ', item()?['name'], ' | ', item()?['owner'], ' | ', item()?['baselineFinish'], ' | ', coalesce(item()?['computedFinish'], 'unknown'), ' | ', if(equals(item()?['slipWorkingDays'], null), 'unknown', string(item()?['slipWorkingDays'])), ' | ', item()?['verdict'], ' |')

Impact_table.inputs: @concat('| Milestone | Owner | Baseline finish | Computed finish | Slip (working days) | Verdict |', decodeUriComponent('%0A'), '|---|---|---|---|---|---|', decodeUriComponent('%0A'), '| ', outputs('Changed_row')?['code'], ' ', outputs('Changed_row')?['name'], ' | ', outputs('Changed_row')?['owner'], ' | ', outputs('Changed_row')?['baselineFinish'], ' | ', outputs('Changed_row')?['computedFinish'], ' | ', string(outputs('Changed_row')?['slipWorkingDays']), ' | Changed (proposed ', outputs('Changed_row')?['proposedFinish'], ') |', if(empty(body('Select_table_rows')), '', concat(decodeUriComponent('%0A'), join(body('Select_table_rows'), decodeUriComponent('%0A')))))

inputs.source: Computed by the AssessChange flow from Dataverse records; not generated by the language model.

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: The user has not confirmed the save. Nothing was written.

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: The change request could not be committed, so neither it nor its Saved audit event was written. Nothing was saved; the save can be retried.

parameters.item/cr458_details: @concat('Save attempt matched the existing request; nothing was written. Fingerprint ', outputs('Fingerprint'))

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: A request with this key was saved from a different assessment result. The existing record was not changed; the baseline data must be versioned before saving again.

parameters.item/cr458_details: @concat('Save attempt rejected: same RequestKey, different assessment result. Stored fingerprint ', coalesce(first(outputs('List_existing')?['body/value'])?['cr458_assessmentfingerprint'], ''), '; attempted ', outputs('Fingerprint'), '. The existing record was not changed.')

inputs.name: ResultMessage
inputs.value: An internal step failed while saving this change request, so nothing was saved. See the run history for the failed action.

status.title: Status
status.description: Created, AlreadyExists, KeyConflict, NotConfirmed, Failed, or an assessment status such as NotFound. The hardened build adds InternalError; Failed and InternalError also fail the run, and a Created request and its Saved audit event are committed together or not at all.

recordid.title: RecordId
recordid.description: Dataverse id of the change request. Empty unless Created or AlreadyExists.

requestkey.title: RequestKey
requestkey.description: Stable key for this assessment. Pass it to ExecuteApprovedPlan.

requeststatus.title: RequestStatus
requeststatus.description: Workflow state of the saved request.
